nom: ILIA The Base Face Milk Lightweight Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the product absorbs quickly, does not add oiliness or greasiness, and still delivers a hydrated, glowy finish.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including eczema and winter dryness, report the product clears dry patches, is soothing, and works well layered with the heavier Barrier Build cream.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe it as balanced and non-overwhelming, though one long-time combination-skin user over 30 says it neither dries her out nor really helps retain water.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin (including eczema) mostly report no breakouts, no rash, and calmed redness, but one reviewer with sensitive skin/eczema says it can burn slightly unless a barrier product is applied first.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention maturing or aging skin report a plumping effect and reduced appearance of fine lines and stress wrinkles.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report visibly reduced fine lines, plumper skin, and improved elasticity or firmness with continued use; no reviewer reports it worsening signs of aging.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, across skin types, report strong, lasting hydration and a plump, smooth feel after use; no reviewer describes it as ineffective for dryness, though one notes it does not particularly improve water retention for her skin.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers with redness-prone or sensitive skin report the product calms and reduces redness over time; no dissent on this point is present.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers report a strengthened or supported moisture barrier, especially when paired with the Ilia Barrier Build cream; one reviewer with sensitive skin/eczema instead reports mild burning unless a barrier layer is applied first.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers state the product does not cause breakouts or pimples, including one who reports no breakouts at all since switching to Ilia products; no reviewer reports new blemishes from use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin consistently report it does not increase oiliness or leave a greasy residue, even in oily-prone areas.

aspects.libelle: Layers well under makeup without pilling
Slightly tacky feel before full absorption

extraits.texte: I find it very odd this product has such high reviews and is so revered. I have combo skin and im over 30 now, my skin has changed drastically. I purchased this product in hopes of getting away from CeraVe noght time moisturizer and using something less drying. I would not say this dries me out but it does not help retain water in my skin, either. And the price for what youre getting is pretty steep. Dermalogica makes way better alternatives and i would rather pay more for a product actually works.

Been using in conjunction with the Ilia Barrier Cream. I like how refreshed this makes my skin and how easy it is to apply makeup after it dries. My biggest complaint is simply I cannot use it alone. I have very sensitive skin and ezcema and if I don't use my body lotion or the Barrier cream first it does burn a little. So I only use it if I'm going to be putting on makeup.

extraits.titre: All about the Base Face Milk
extraits.texte: I was looking forward to trying some of the skincare from Ilia.The Ilia Base Face Milk is a lovely lightweight formula that is deceiving. Even though it is lightweight a little goes a long way and it packs some major hydration punch!The glass bottle has a nice pour design as it doesn't allow product to simply flood out.I have sensitive skin and I tend to experience some redness every once in a while.This product helps to calm that redness and strengthens my skin barrier.I love how smooth my face feels after applying it. Hours later my skin still feels smooth and hydrated.I have been using this in the morning and evening and following it with the Ilia Barrier Build Skin Protectant Cream.My face feels hydrated, plump, smooth and appears healthy and radiant.I love what this does for my skin and highly recommend it! I received this product complimentary from Ilia in exchange for my honest opinion.

extraits.titre: Best Thing Yet I Have Added to My Nightly Skin Regimen
extraits.texte: I have sensitive skin, it sometimes reacts negatively to new products, especially when it comes to moisturizer. I was pleased at the results of using this product. Maybe this is the type of moisturizer that I should be using and the technique of applying it as well. First, it's light weight, non-greasy, and easily absorbs into my skin. A white cream liquid that you pat into your face. (This is a method I had not thought about before and maybe that is a better way of applying some beauty products.) I put this on after washing, applying serum, allowing the serum to set a minute, then patting on Ilia Base Face Milk Essence. Since I have started using this (and will continue to do so), my complexion is alive, supple, skin tone is more even, no redness to speak of (which has been a problem for me in the cheeks), the overall look of my face has improved and that is the only thing I have changed in recent weeks is adding The Base Face to my nightly routine. I'm keeping it! I love it!

Thank you @iliabeauty for allowing me to test and review Ilia The Base Face Milk I was very excited to try it because I do suffer from eczema and I had read that they help with hydration. The bottles that they come in are sleek, white/clear and very nice in my opinion. The Base Face Milk by Ilia is wonderful! You apply 2-3 shakes of the Milk onto your hands and apply to your face. It feels very light and liquidy. It is not thick or creamy at all. It absords quickly and my face feels cool and hydrated when I apply and not tight at all. I am obsessed with the products. I will definitely be purchasing the Base Face Milk to replace my current essence spray. I recommend both products to anyone who has dry skin and needs extra hydration!

I recently purchased the ILIA Base Face Milk, and I could not get over how hydrated and glowy it made my skin look! I struggle with dry and peeling skin, and this helps in my skincare routine, and works like MAGIC underneath makeup and makes it look hydrated and fresh all day long! It is a little pricey, but totally worth it if you want bouncy, hydrated, and plump skin! Totally recommend for the dry skin girlies! LOVE IT!

I am in love with the ILIA Base Face Milk Essence and Lightweight Moisturizer. It's refreshing and lightweight. It is just the right amount of hydrating ingredients for my extreme Combination Skin. It easily absorbs with no funky or greasy feeling. It's perfect under makeup. It just works very well. Highly Recommend
